Establish an independent, multi-stakeholder authority responsible for overseeing the restructuring process.

Impose sunset clauses on existing regulations that benefit these companies, forcing them to be re-evaluated and potentially replaced with more equitable and forward-looking rules.

Create a public data trust to manage and distribute data assets previously controlled by these companies.

Implement a "right to repair" for AI systems, giving individuals and independent developers access to the necessary tools and information to modify and repair these technologies.
